notes: engine/fundamental_forensics/specialist_packs/base.py:959 (representative-only unit gate; ids joined at base.py:996–1004) — in a duplicate group with equal values but different units (USD+EUR at the same instant), the R-F1 unit check tests only the `representative` occurrence (chosen by occurrence-id order, base.py:951): when the USD fact is representative the valued row's `source_occurrence_ids` cites the EUR-tagged duplicate as co-evidence with no typed absence for it, and which outcome occurs (valued vs `unit_mismatch`) hinges on id ordering. Demonstrated live (T3c vs T3c-clean). The emitted value itself is never wrong (both duplicates agree numerically; differing values across units hit the `unit_mismatch` conflict branch), so NOTE not DEFECT. Minimal fix: gate the whole `admitted` group (any non-equivalent unit → `unit_mismatch`) instead of the representative.

base.py:1883 (`_identity_tolerance`, used by the weighted sum at base.py:2081–2097 and rollforward at base.py:2127–2140) — tolerance is one unit of the coarsest stated `decimals`; a 6–7-line reconciliation or rollforward whose disclosed lines foot only within accumulated rounding (up to N×0.5 units, e.g. 3M for six decimals=-6 lines against a 1M tolerance) can FAIL an economically tied identity. Conservative direction (false-fail, never false-value). Minimal fix: tolerance = half the sum of operand rounding units (or Σ 0.5-unit) for multi-addend identities.

pk05_tax.py:201–209 (`_decimals_of` fallback) — a disclosed ETR tagged `decimals="INF"` (claims exactness) falls back to the value's own scale (0.2 → tolerance 0.1), so `etr_formula_vs_disclosed` can PASS a formula that contradicts an "exact" disclosed rate. Rare input (INF on a rate), display-only check. Minimal fix: treat INF as tolerance 0 (or the formula's 6-dp quantum).

engine/fundamental_forensics/specialist_packs/pk05_tax.py:26–36 / calculation_linkbase.py:8–12 — the FX-translation/acquisition UTP movement lines (three standard spellings) map to no catalogue field, so `utp_rollforward` fails on such filings instead of absorbing them; this is a declared, typed limit (the identity goes `not_evaluable`, never invents the line), recorded here because a domain consumer will meet it on real filings.

notes: engine/fundamental_forensics/specialist_packs/pk06_leases.py:60-65,81-86,111-119 — the `undiscounted_minus_imputed_equals_liability` identity structurally fails on internally consistent filings: the first alias of `undiscounted_payments_total`/`lease_imputed_interest` is the operating-only ladder, while the liability side always adds `finance_lease_liability_total`; verified on the golden AAPL fixture (2,235+12,490+1,230=15,955 vs 14,725 → fail) and synthetic case B (13,100−2,100=11,000 ✓ operating identity holds, yet check=fail), and in case I a filing tagging BOTH ladders resolves to the operating-only one even though the combined alias present would satisfy the identity — minimal fix: a producer-declared limitation naming the ladder-scope behavior (the honest-fail intent lives only in the code comment, pk06_leases.py:106-110, not in the envelope).

engine/fundamental_forensics/specialist_packs/pk06_leases.py:57-59 + base.py:62,1026-1030 — a percent-basis tagged discount rate (`OperatingLeaseWeightedAverageDiscountRatePercent` = 4.1, pure) is emitted as `value=4.1, unit="ratio"` (verified scenario A): the no-rescale pass-through is lawful but the frozen catalogue's "ratio" unit mislabels a percent number (4.1 reads as 410%), and no limitation names the basis — minimal fix: a limitation line declaring the pass-through basis.

engine/fundamental_forensics/specialist_packs/pk06_leases.py:54-56 — `weighted_average_remaining_term` can never value at this producer version (string element; the numeric-only converter excludes nonnumeric facts, ixbrl_raw_ledger.py:334-335) — honest (declared limitation, typed `missing`), but the field is structurally dead.

base.py:1895-1904 — the scalar `disjoint` reading (|left−right| > tolerance) treats magnitude equality as double counting: verified 42,000,000 commitments vs coincidentally-equal 42,000,000 PK08 accrual → `fail`, vs 5,000,000 → `pass`; equality is neither necessary nor sufficient for overlap, so the check's name promises more than the comparison delivers (conservative direction; no value emitted).

base.py:2310-2316 — in the two-spec merged `lease_liability_split_vs_total` row, `not_evaluable` outranks `fail`: a genuinely broken operating split (2.0+9.0≠12.0, verified) reports `not_evaluable` when the finance half is unresolvable — masks a real arithmetic break, though never into a `pass`.

pk06_leases.py:120-125 — the boundary's "avoid double counting" clause has no leases-vs-debt counterpart: finance-lease liabilities that also sit inside PK01 debt are emitted with no cross-pack disjointness check or limitation (only commitments-vs-PK08 has one); the pack itself emits no aggregate so it cannot double count internally — the exposure is downstream summation, unmarked.

pk06_leases.py:53,60 — generic field names over operating-only concepts (`lease_cash_payments`→`OperatingLeasePayments`; `undiscounted_payments_total` whose scope varies by which alias resolves): each row carries its `concept` so the basis stays traceable, but the field name alone overstates scope.

pk06_leases.py:132-135 — `undiscounted_payments_by_year` produces only the next-twelve-months row; honestly declared as an envelope limitation (matches catalogue intent; the by-year maturity table is deferred).
